summary: Formal issue relations must be discoverable, directional, fully paginated, and reflected in local snapshots when Linear replaces a relation.
reason: A reprint removed the earlier issue-relation commands; blocked-by reverses the blocks direction, and changing relation type can replace the existing edge for the same issue pair.
validated_outcome: Stub GraphQL tests fail when the blocked-by mapping or the inverse labels are swapped; strict trust mode refuses dry-runs and live writes alike with no request sent. Focused command regressions cover stalled cursors, uppercase UUIDs, repeated adds and type replacement with timestamp/null metadata retained.
